context:
Goal: combined PR #3418 (21 members) merges, and your two rulings on closed routed answers land, without a new way for a named act to run twice.
Problem (rule): the round 1 reviewer of #3418 (PASS, record comment 6884294991, relayed by lane g1 at 15:14 CST) found one narrow path in two members, #3224 (rule 4, routed_close) and #3308 (a Relayed Grant entry): the owning session counts its own kept routed answer before the receiver reports done (docs/decisions/relayed-grant-read-from-page.md, around line 60). Harm: the named act runs a second time. Only you can say whether that path is inside your rulings.
Based on (ruling): own-748-b-rule-4 (owner 13:20 CST Nov 13): the lane lands page_grant rule 4 as in closed PR #1383, so a closed routed answer keeps a counted grant route; "he chose it knowing the label". And own-753-a-relayed-grant-entry (owner 18:24 CST Nov 13): edit the "Relayed Grant" entry (settings.json line 56) and its pinned test so a routed closed item counts. #3224 and #3308 are the implementation of those two rulings (coordinator, 15:17 CST, after it read both), so the receiver's routed case is NOT at stake. Neither ruling names the owning session counting its own kept answer before the receiver reports done; a grant covers the act it names, never a variant.
Based on (read): main's settings.json line 56 ("Relayed Grant") carries "Never covers ... a closed item" (coordinator, 15:14). Based on (unread): the versions of #3224 and #3308 inside the combine; the reviewer's words only.
Departs from: main refuses a grant on a closed item; #3224 and #3308 land your 748 b and 753 a, so a routed closed item counts for the receiver; the narrow path above comes with them unless a lane fixes it.
Corrected 15:17 CST Nov 14 (coordinator, 15:17): the first text of this item said #3418 allows a grant on a closed item, with options a, b and c where c read as refusing a closed item again. The coordinator wrote that without searching your rulings; that option c is withdrawn, because it undid your two rulings.
Meanwhile: lane g1 holds the lane lint and hands nothing in until you answer; it reads a merge-tree of the other 19 members. Nothing else waits.
Option a is starred at the coordinator's recommendation (it undoes neither ruling, it only delays them).
Also, as a note, not a question (the reviewer, relayed): it could not run runtime verdicts for the archive guard, because its sandbox refused the probes (they include a deny-expected branch delete, so they need a plain checkout with that branch absent): unknown. Pre-existing: the archive guard reads one command only.
home: step page-grant-closed-item-leftovers; PRs #3224 and #3308; combined PR #3418; rulings own-748-b-rule-4 and own-753-a-relayed-grant-entry
